newsitem.title: GERMANY: Air France adds 5th daily Berlin-Paris flight.
newsitem.headline: Air France adds 5th daily Berlin-Paris flight.

text.p: Air France said it will add a fifth daily Berlin Tegel to Paris Charles de Gaulle service from March 30.
The additional flight has been prompted by a 40 percent rise in passenger numbers for the airline between the two capitals over the last year, a statement said.
Air France operates three of the current services with an Airbus 320 and the fourth with a Boeing 737-300.
The new evening service connected to intercontinental services to South America, the Indian Ocean and Africa, and offered business travellers a full working day in Paris, the airline said.
